reason: I'd happily try the free tricks on the kids at Friday dinner, but 99 ₪ for an app I'm not sure I'll use past a few weeks feels like too much. Most apps I pay for cost a few shekels.
objection: 99 ₪ up front for something installed from a website, not the App Store, and I don't know if the trick will still fool my family the second or third Friday.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks really floor the whole table at Friday dinner and the kids beg for more, I'd pay, especially if it were closer to 50 ₪.
